feeds.title: Elysium Cabaret Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates from Elysium Cabaret on shows and events. Every Friday at 6pm SLT, Elysium Cabaret takes the stage in The Empire Room at Copperhead Road. We strive to present fabulous dance shows that involve an eclectic mix of music, dancers and styles, elaborate staging and costumes.

feeds.title: UK Cabaret
feeds.description: UK Cabaret the publication for artists, agents, venues and suppliers to the light entertainment business. You have just discovered a publication totally and exclusively dedicated to cabaret in all forms and cabaret performers, producers and suppliers of all types.

feeds.title: Cabaret Scenes » Listings and News
feeds.description: Get the latest news and updates on new listings and events scheduled, news on artists and more. Established in 1995, Cabaret Scenes magazine is the only print publication in the world that focuses on the excitement of cabaret its songs, its performers, its songwriters, and the clubs in which the magic happens.

feeds.title: Electric Cabaret Company Blog
feeds.description: Electric Cabaret Company blogs about entertainment trends, creative event ideas, event themes, event planning and more. Unique entertainment, immersive shows, pop up acts, comedy cabaret, themed interactive performance and more. We have a huge cast based in London and Brighton and are constantly writing new exciting shows.

feeds.title: Chicago Cabaret Magazine Blog
feeds.description: Chicago Cabaret Magazine is produced and published by Chicago Cabaret Professionals. Chicago Cabaret Professionals is an alliance of advocates for the art of cabaret who have come together to promote public appreciation of Cabaret. Members include seasoned and aspiring performers, composers, lyricists, producers, directors, writers, presenters, venues and friends.

feeds.title: The Cabaret Geek Blog
feeds.description: With over 30 years' experience as a cabaret compère Paulus is at hand to prepare you for the new roaring twenties. Whether you are looking for an emcee for your party, a cabaret host, or want to learn what cabaret even is, get your Gatsby on with the help of Paulus' three decades of knowledge on hedonism, indulgence and celebrating together once more.

feeds.title: Acts Of Kindness Cabaret Blog
feeds.description: Learn the many ways we use the art of cabaret (storytelling through song) to help nonprofit organizations raise funds, cultivate donors, and build community. Acts Of Kindness Cabaret is a performing arts non-profit fueled by exceptional talent. Believing in the inspiring power of simple kindness and the artistic value of cabaret, it is our mission to help other Chicago-area non-profits raise funds and cultivate donors by providing professional, entertaining cabaret events almost entirely free of charge.

feeds.title: Invisible Cabaret
feeds.description: Find articles on the troupe, artists, upcoming shows and venues and more. Invisible cabaret is a burlesque/ vaudeville variety troupe, dedicated to raising mental health awareness.
